name: Document / 2-pager (A4)
note: Specification approved by the brand team on 2026-10-14. Padding, header and footer follow their Figma page (Design MCP, frame '5'): 26pt on 595 × 842 pt = 36px (spacing/36) at 794 × 1123 px. Every font is a named text style and every value a token. Logo size may vary; its position does not.

header.layout: One row across the top of the content area, items top-aligned
header.left: Context label, e.g. '// Cement Manufacturing //' — optional, the user decides the text
header.logo_size: may vary per document; default height spacing/32

footer.when: Used whenever the user does not specify a footer; a footer the user specifies replaces it.

keep_together: any UI card (Card, Metric, Icon, Highlight, Media, Profile, FAQ, Banner)
image or figure with its caption
page_breaks.keep_together_rule: If it does not fit in the space left on the page, move the whole block to the next page; never cut it.
page_breaks.may_split_rule: Text may continue on the next page, breaking between lines.

footer_zone.position: bottom of the content area, on the 36px bottom padding

page_breaks.content_bottom_limit_note: Nothing goes below 1045px from the top of the page: page height 1123 − bottom padding 36 − footer 18 − gap/grid 24.

guardrails.note: Guidance for whoever designs in this format. user_decides = what is made (the user's call); fixed = do not change; must_not = hard limits; avoid = strong advice; design_direction = how to use the system; claude_decides = how it looks, where the designer has freedom. Every design item cites its basis in the design system.
user_decides: What is being made, for whom and why: the deliverable, its format, purpose and audience.
The content and facts. The designer uses exactly what the user supplies or approves: never invents, adds, rewrites, shortens or cuts it, and asks before suggesting a change.
The scope: which sections, pages or slides. Nothing is added that was not asked for; when it is unclear, ask.
Whether it is a 2-pager or a longer document.
The header's context label, if any, and a footer if it should differ from the default.

fixed.text: A4 portrait, 794 × 1123 px at 96 dpi. A 2-pager is exactly 2 pages; other documents can run longer.
36px padding on all four sides (spacing/36); content is 722px wide.
Text uses the text style set for its element (e.g. title Heading/H2 Semi Bold, body Body/SM, caption Body/XS), never a raw size.
Header row: optional context label at the left, the blue logo at the top-right (its size may vary).
Footer by default: '© Faclon Labs | All Rights Reserved' at the left and a two-digit page number at the right, in Body/XS Medium, text/brand, no divider. A footer the user specifies replaces it.
Cards are built on Card base, as a named card or a new design, and keep its tone's fill, border, radius and padding; at most 3 cards in a row.

must_not.text: Hard rule: never edit or change the user's content (no rewriting, shortening, cutting or adding). If a change seems needed, highlight it, suggest how it could be shown better, and change nothing unless the user approves.
Never let text overflow the canvas padding on any side, or the card, box, zone or node it sits in.

Never cut a UI card, a table row, an image with its caption, or a heading from its first paragraph across a page break; if it does not fit, move it whole to the next page. Paragraphs and lists may continue on the next page.
Never let content run into the footer: everything stops gap/grid (24px) above it, at most 1045px from the top of the page.
Never let a 2-pager run past two pages.
Never make an image wider than the 722px content width, or leave it without alt text in HTML.
Never use a colour that is not a design-system token, and never sample or approximate one.
Never use a font other than TASA Orbiter (headings) and Inter (body).
Never use in-between font sizes: text comes from Role/* or the defined text styles.
Never put a pill radius on a card, panel, container, input or image.
Never place an eyebrow on container/secondary or container/tertiary (it fails contrast).
Never combine a shadow with a border of 2px or more.

avoid.text: Avoid using the accent colours (accent and accent-2 together) on more than roughly 10–15% of the piece; it is a highlight, not a palette.
Avoid text/tertiary for essential text; at 3.4:1 it is for large or non-essential text only.
Avoid giving every section the same card design. Repeat a design only where the content repeats, such as a set of like items in one row or grid.

design_direction.text: Pick spacing by purpose: gap/inline between adjacent items, gap/stack inside a component, gap/grid between cards, padding/container inside cards, padding/section between sections.
Cards and panels use the container default: container/primary, 1px border/container, radius/default, padding/container. Nest with container/secondary, then container/tertiary.

Design each section's cards for its content. The named cards are starting points; when none fits, build a new card on Card base: pick a tone, then arrange atoms, controls and text roles in its slot with spacing tokens (for example number-led, image-led, split, stat row, steps or comparison). Cards in one row or grid share one design; vary the design between sections.
Headings use text/heading, body copy text/body, eyebrows text/eyebrow.
Show status with the five intents (Positive, Negative, Information, Neutral, Primary) and their fixed fill/text pairs; warnings use Negative.
Keep surfaces flat; use Low Raised only to lift a card off the canvas.
Buttons have softened square corners (radius/default), never pill.
When an icon helps, use Lucide and colour it with a text token that suits the surface.
If the content is too much for the space, do not squeeze it below the minimum size or cut it: tell the user, and offer options (split across slides or pages, a different layout, a table or chart).

claude_decides: Layout and composition within the grid: what goes where, how many columns, what leads.
Visual hierarchy: what is large, what is quiet, and how the eye moves.
Which components to use and how to combine them, and new card designs on Card base when the named cards don't fit the content.
How to show each idea: a stat, a process, a comparison, a story.
How the content flows across the pages: where paragraphs break, and when a whole card moves to the next page.
to_define: Widow and orphan rules (no single word on its own line).
Logo minimum size and clear space.

card.spec: Card default tone: container/primary, 1px border/container, radius/default, padding/container, flat
card.why_max: Card minimum width is 200px; 3 × 200 + 2 × gap/grid fits the 722px content width

new_card.use: content none of the named cards fit
new_card.spec: A new card on Card base: the tone's fill, border, radius and padding; atoms, controls and text roles arranged freely in the slot with spacing tokens

highlight.spec: Card Selected (container/selected + border/brand) or Brand (container/brand + text/on-brand)

status.spec: Card Positive / Negative: container/success + border/success + text/success (or error)

metric.spec: Metric Card: metric + label, optional chip for trend

features.spec: Icon Card / Highlight Card: Lucide icon, title, body

media.spec: Media Card: Image up to the content width, radius/default, alt text; placeholder until provided

quote.spec: Profile Card: status chip, title, body, Divider, avatar + name/role

faq.spec: FAQ Card: Accordion Items with Dividers

tags.spec: Chip / Badge in the five intents; Badge sizes S / M / L
